brief: Design a 24-hour hackathon prototype that helps neighborhood volunteers coordinate safe water collection after a flood. The demo must run without internet access, use only invented sample data, and work for screen-reader users. No personal names or phone numbers may be collected.

hard_constraints.text: No internet or cloud dependency in the demo.
Use invented sample data only; do not collect personal names or phone numbers.
The interaction must work with a screen reader.
